### Accuracy / publishing notes
- All recovered-password workflows are for files owned by the user or explicitly authorized.
- Do not claim GPU support for every RAR, 7Z or PDF; RAR4, 7Z and PDF remain CPU-only.
- Both social examples refer to supported browser-local checks, not universal password bypass.
- Posts have only been drafted in GitHub; **not sent to X or Mastodon**.
